name: com.stockdatum/sec-filings
title: StockDatum SEC filings
description: SEC Form 4, 8-K/6-K, Form 144 and insider clusters for AI agents, paid per call in USDC (x402).

tools.name: form4
tools.description: Form 4 insider transactions (one row per transaction line). Price 0.02 USDC per call on eip155:8453. Same parameters as GET /v1/form4. A valid call that returns zero rows is not settled. A bad parameter after a verified payment is not settled.

cik.description: SEC CIK, 1-10 digits (ticker or cik required)

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD; filters filed_date >= since. Rows sort by accepted_utc, and after-hours filings carry the next day's filed_date.

code.description: One Form 4 transaction code, e.g. P, S

limit.description: 1-200, default 50 (not clamped: out of range is a 400)

tools.name: eightk
tools.description: 8-K / 6-K filings with item tags. Price 0.02 USDC per call on eip155:8453. Same parameters as GET /v1/8k. A valid call that returns zero rows is not settled. A bad parameter after a verified payment is not settled.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD; filters filed_date >= since. Rows sort by accepted_utc, and after-hours filings carry the next day's filed_date.

tag.description: One of the 0/1 tag columns; returns rows where it is 1

limit.description: 1-200, default 50 (not clamped: out of range is a 400)

tools.name: form144
tools.description: Form 144 proposed-sale notices with Form 4 match status. Price 0.02 USDC per call on eip155:8453. Same parameters as GET /v1/form144. A valid call that returns zero rows is not settled. A bad parameter after a verified payment is not settled.

cik.description: SEC CIK, 1-10 digits (ticker or cik required)

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD; filters filed_date >= since. Rows sort by accepted_utc, and after-hours filings carry the next day's filed_date.

limit.description: 1-200, default 50 (not clamped: out of range is a 400)

tools.name: clusters
tools.description: Insider purchase clusters (latest run only). Price 0.03 USDC per call on eip155:8453. Same parameters as GET /v1/clusters. A valid call that returns zero rows is not settled. A bad parameter after a verified payment is not settled.

view.description: default = default_view=1 rows (default); all = every row of the latest run

limit.description: 1-200, default 50 (not clamped: out of range is a 400)

tools.name: sample
tools.description: The 5 newest rows of a dataset that are at least 24 hours old. Same response as GET /sample/{dataset}. No payment.

tools.name: probe
tools.description: Service probe. Returns {"ok":true} when this endpoint is answering. It does not report coverage or freshness.
